title: Quartered Node Failure Bits Bound
statement: For all $k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, let $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, and let $\delta=1/(4T_k2^{b+1})$. The failure-bit count $\left\lceil\log_2\left\lceil 2/\delta\right\rceil\right\rceil$ is at most $\bigl(\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+1)+5\bigr)(b+1)$.
